summary: Practise adaptive technology decisions, incident communication and change leadership. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Dynamic technology leadership helps project managers and technical leads adapt decisions and team practices as delivery conditions change. For technology project managers, emerging engineering leads and technical specialists, the course offers practical ways to assess decision contexts, record shifting priorities and guide technology change. You practise using Cynefin and OODA, applying ADKAR and RACI, and preparing incident updates that explain risks and ownership to technical and business stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who coordinate technology work or are taking on leadership responsibilities within technical teams. It suits professionals who need practical methods for making decisions, guiding change and keeping delivery conversations productive.
modules: Ladder of Inference for Tech Leads
prerequisites: Working familiarity with technology project, product or operational work is useful. No prior formal leadership role or coding is required; exercises use written scenarios and leadership artefacts rather than software configuration.
